description: Calçadas dos Corredores de Transporte Metropolitano is a dataset listed in City of Recife open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaria de Infraestrutura. Calçadas dos Corredores de Transporte Metropolitano. As dimensões das vias e a largura média das calçadas foram baseadas no banco de dados do ARQGIS. Coverage: Recife. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaria de Infraestrutura. Its tags are Calçadas, Ruas. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, PDF. The portal shows 2026-03-02 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-recife-portal.
